backend/main.mo: Motoko canister storing up to 20 stories with add, get, and sorted list retrieval.
feature_evidence.json: Structured feature evidence listing features, related files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of multiple frontend files for quick reference.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS theme defining warm color variables and dark-mode overrides.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up React Query and TanStack Router for TOC and story pages.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Shared layout with header, footer, and PDF download button wrapping routed pages.
frontend/src/components/AudioNarrationCo: UI controls for speech narration with play, pause, restart, and progress bar.
frontend/src/components/DownloadPdfButto: Triggers PDF generation of all stories with loading, error handling, and retry.
frontend/src/content/storyAssets.ts: Maps story numbers to illustration and coloring asset paths plus cover asset getter.
frontend/src/features/pdf/exportEbookPdf: Builds a print-ready HTML document with cover, story pages, and images for PDF export.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, login flow, and stored identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exposes React Query hooks that fetch stories or a single story using the authenticated actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSpeechNarration.ts: Implements speech synthesis playback with play, pause, restart, and progress tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and theme variables for light and dark mode along with global font and base styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app by rendering React with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers.
frontend/src/pages/StoryReaderPage.tsx: Displays a story with navigation, loading states, audio narration controls, and error handling.
frontend/src/pages/TableOfContentsPage.t: Shows a list of story entries with loading and error states, allowing navigation to individual stories.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme extensions, colors, animations, plugins, and enables class-based dark mode.
project_state.json: Project metadata for a children’s Bible stories ebook app and a list of required illustrations and coloring pages for 20 stories.
